title: Finite Isom sheaves with normalization-compatible evaluation
statement: Let X be a scheme, d an adic coefficient datum on A, φ quotient- and scalar-compatible isomorphisms of constant quotient and finite coefficient sheaves, M a derived completed-coefficient module, V an etale X-chart, and T a supplied normalized algebraic tower with perfect levels [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data]. Assume separate local finite-level markings by T [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-stalk-models]. There are finite locally constant etale sheaves I_n of sets on V with nonempty geometric stalks, reduction maps r_n:I_(n+1)→I_n, and evaluation of their comparison-pullback sections on every affine weakly contractible pro-etale U over V. Evaluation gives isomorphisms from the actual strict quotient diagram level to the completed constant algebraic level, also after restriction to every X-pro-etale W mapping to U. Evaluation of reduction satisfies the consecutive naturality square for the actual strict diagram and model diagram. There is no covering or compatible section in this assertion.

source.place: Tags 09BV and 0F63, finite derived Isom sections and normalization; Tag 09C6, scalar-compatible identification of the actual finite quotient diagram.

proof.text: Obtain a normalized etale presheaf presentation from the supplied perfect algebraic tower and separate finite-level markings.

Define I_n as the sheafification of the presentation Isom presheaf and r_n by sheafifying p_n. Apply finite-ring derived local constancy to C_n,K_n to prove I_n finite locally constant; use the supplied inhabited Isom stalks.

Evaluate the pulled-back sections by canonical source-site evaluation. The preservation lemma turns the presheaf generator normalization equation into a raw evaluated square. The presentation transports this square along W to U to the forward square for the actual diagrams. Invert each evaluated transport isomorphism; cancellation of its hom and inverse proves the exact square in the theorem.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09C6, 09BV and 0F63; finite-ring local constancy, sheafification of presheaf reduction and inverse-square cancellation. Raw etale presentation and evaluation preservation are split off separately.

theorem finitePerfectAdic_isomorphism_sections
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d)
    (hperfect : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n))
    (hmark : FinitePerfectAdicLevelMarkings X d φ M V T) :
    ∃ (I : ℕ → Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology (Type (t + 1)))
      (r : ∀ n : ℕ, I (n + 1) ⟶ I n)
      (ev : ∀ (U : V.left.ProEt), IsAffine U.left →
        (ProEt.topology V.left).IsWeaklyContractible.{t + 1} U →
        ∀ (W : X.ProEt), (W ⟶ finitePerfectAdicChartObject V U) → ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (toProEt V.left)
          (Type (t + 1)) V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ProEt.topology V.left)).obj (I n)).obj.obj
            (op U) →
        ((finitePerfectAdicRestrictedTower X d W ((completedAdicReduction X d).obj M)).obj
            (op n) ≅ (finitePerfectAdicModelDiagram X d W T).obj (op n))),
      (∀ n : ℕ, IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets (I n)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Type t) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
        (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V.left), Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj (I n))) ∧
      ∀ (U : V.left.ProEt) (ha : IsAffine U.left)
        (hw : (ProEt.topology V.left).IsWeaklyContractible.{t + 1} U)
        (W : X.ProEt) (f : W ⟶ finitePerfectAdicChartObject V U) (n : ℕ)
        (s : ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (toProEt V.left)
          (Type (t + 1)) V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ProEt.topology V.left)).obj
            (I (n + 1))).obj.obj (op U)),
        (finitePerfectAdicRestrictedTower X d W ((completedAdicReduction X d).obj M)).map
            (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op ≫
          (ev U ha hw W f n
            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (toProEt V.left)
              (Type (t + 1)) V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ProEt.topology V.left)).map
                (r n)).hom.app (op U) s)).hom =
          (ev U ha hw W f (n + 1) s).hom ≫
            (finitePerfectAdicModelDiagram X d W T).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
